stories.title: Independent borough councillor defects to Reform
stories.summary: Steve Carter becomes the party's first councillor on Melton Borough Council.

stories.title: M1 reopens after multi-vehicle crash
stories.summary: National Highways says recovery is complete and all lanes are open on the M1.

stories.title: Item that prompted A&E evacuation was e-bike charger
stories.summary: A 44-year-old man was arrested at the scene on suspicion of immigration offences.

stories.title: Pre-school told to make urgent improvements
stories.summary: The inspection earlier this year found safeguarding standards at the pre-school were not met.

stories.title: PC who called person a 'rat' guilty of misconduct
stories.summary: PC Rifat Khan also told a female officer to dress "more modestly", a gross misconduct hearing heard.

stories.title: Anti-terror blocks installed around new square
stories.summary: Part of the new-look market square reopens to pedestrians but the blocks are to keep vehicles out.

stories.title: Christmas reprieve for man with dementia facing deportation
stories.summary: The Swedish authorities initially said they wanted George Mason to leave the country by 20 August.

stories.title: Blue plaque unveiled at ex-Leicester striker's home
stories.summary: The blue plaque is unveiled at the childhood home of footballer Frank Worthington, who died in 2021.

stories.title: Passengers leave plane after knife found in wheelchair
stories.summary: Police say the blade fell out of a passenger's wheelchair as it was being loaded into the hold.

stories.title: Warnings issued for breaches of Diwali drone rules
stories.summary: The operators ignored restrictions during the celebrations, which attracted about 30,000 people.

stories.title: Next data accessed in cyber breach
stories.summary: The fashion retailer says there is no evidence customers' personal data was compromised.

stories.title: A6 roundabout revamp is wrong priority, says MP
stories.summary: An A6 roundabout is being reshaped - but some think nearby junctions should be tackled first.
